evidence: Every negative / refusal / absence leg in the shipped criteria is paired with a matching success observed in the same review, and the functional prompt adds a global backstop. Global rules: functional/prompt.md:13 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.'; prompt.md:17 every role replay must use the card's current version, be otherwise legal, and 'Send the same fresh request as Rafael afterwards (or before, on another card) as its control; a refusal for a duplicate, a skip or a full stage does not count as the role refusal' (prevents a stale/invalid-request refusal or a dead endpoint being credited as role enforcement); prompt.md:11-13 the gate (UI add + reload + independent Observer readback) zeroes every binary row for a blank/static/no-op app. Per-criterion pairing (functional/judge.toml): hro_job_open L31 'the successful opening is the control'; hro_add_email_rules L49 'The same address on a different job is accepted (the control)' and typed values must stay in the form; hro_move_one_stage L58 skip refusals paired with forward/back one-stage success; hro_reject_reason L85 blank refused + reason accepted; hro_reject_hired L94 'A rejection of a non-hired card is the control'; hro_reopen L103 wrong-stage refusal paired with reopen to own stage and undo; hro_interview_full L112 'the two cards that entered Interview are the control'; hro_undo_full L130 'once a place is freed the same undo goes ahead ... (the same-kind control)'; hro_mgr_early_refused L157 'their late-stage moves are the control' (reject/reorder/reopen same-kind successes are performed by Ingrid in protocol R, prompt.md:53, and open-job/add-candidate controls are Rafael's identical requests per prompt.md:17); hro_mgr_other_job L166 own manager's move; hro_observer_readonly L175 'Rafael's identical successful requests are the control'; hro_candidate_no_staff L184 session control + staff same-kind control, 'or the staff control did not succeed' fails; hro_anonymous L193 'A signed-in success of each is the control'; hro_stale_refused L211 original move; hro_bulk_all_or_none L229 successful multi-card moves; hro_bulk_places L238 later two-card move; hro_undo_conflict L256 unrelated-change undo goes ahead; hro_undo_once L265 successful undos; hro_activity_refusals L283 'The successful actions' lines are the control'; hro_notes L292 permitted notes by Recruiter and own manager; hro_msg_compose L319 'A normal send is the control' (and the blank refusal / box-empty-after-reload legs follow a real send); hro_unread_counts L346 'does not raise' and 'own messages never count' paired with the rise-by-two leg; hro_unread_scrolled_up L355 'does not move his place' paired with the notice appearing; hro_seen L364 not-seen paired with seen after Tomas/Bill/Rafael; hro_thread_access L373 'Rafael's own read and send are the controls'; hro_drafts L382 no-migration paired with draft kept; hro_candidate_private L400 own applications/conversations load (the control), Rafael's identical read succeeds (control), 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0'; hro_restart L418 'not loaded again' paired with seeded order/note and all session data persisting across restart_app. Gates: render judge.toml L25 wrong password leaves signed out, then correct password signs in, and gates/render/prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'. Polish: hro_pol_live_board L25 and hro_pol_live_thread L34 'If no update arrives within 15 seconds, preservation cannot be shown and this row is 0' (a dead live feed cannot earn the preservation row); hro_pol_failed_send L52 'send again: it is sent once'; hro_pol_session_resume L61 reply sends after re-sign-in 'which is the positive control', Mei-sees-empty paired with Rafael's drafts still present. Visual rows are Likert craft with no negative legs. Weak-app probes: (a) an app that refuses every write (e.g. all non-add writes 403) fails the gate's sibling controls: hro_reject_hired, hro_bulk_*, hro_undo_*, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous, hro_thread_access all lose their named control; hro_refusal_status additionally requires C's out-of-date replay to carry 409, which an all-403 app cannot produce. (b) An Interview cap that always refuses (places parsed as 0) fails hro_interview_full (control 'two cards that entered') and hro_move_one_stage; hro_refused_put_back can still credit the refusal presentation only if the refusal is actually put back with a reason and focus, which is a real working behaviour, not absence of evidence. (c) A conforming alternative that hides refused controls (no UI offer) is not failed: prompt.md:31 and the rows ('hiding it is optional', 'Whether the Observer's screens show such controls is the app's choice') grade server refusal by replay with Rafael's success as control. Lessons file patterns checked: lesson 9 (judge over-passes / skipped steps) is covered by prompt.md:23-25 'A step you skipped ... fails that criterion'; lesson 7/14 timing void handling at prompt.md:21 does not let a void attempt pass a negative; lesson 15 restart check re-reads many items and pairs 'not loaded again' with persistence; lesson 16 double-penalty avoided because hro_refusal_status L202 deducts accepted replays only in their own rows. Non-blocking hardening observations (not defects, since prompt.md:13/17 supply the control and no leg passes on absence of evidence): hro_refusal_status (L202) and hro_refused_put_back (L139) name no in-criterion control, and hro_mgr_early_refused (L157) names only moves as its control although its legs include reject/reorder/reopen/open-job/add-candidate; an author could add 'counts only where Rafael's identical request succeeded' / 'with Interview holding its two placed cards (the control)' to make each row self-contained.
